description: This file defines test utility classes for HTTP/2 frame decoder listener testing, including a failing listener and a logging wrapper, within the http2 namespace.

classes.name: FailingHttp2FrameDecoderListener
classes.description: A test utility class that fails on all method calls, used to verify behavior when listener methods are invoked.

classes.name: LoggingHttp2FrameDecoderListener
classes.description: A wrapper class that logs all method calls and forwards them to an optional wrapped listener, used for debugging and tracing.
